high_level_description: The image shows a person standing on a red carpet at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF). The backdrop features the TIFF logo prominently displayed along with other logos such as "Telefilm Canada" and "Choice." The individual is wearing a black, sleeveless dress with a deep V-neckline that drapes elegantly over the chest. The dress has a fitted silhouette that accentuates the figure. The person is accessorized with gold bracelets on both wrists, adding a touch of glamour to the outfit. Their hair is styled in loose waves, cascading down their shoulders.
